verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Caveman Cloud has keys with per-key rate limits, project-level spend caps, and an audit trail covering keys and roles. None of it documents issuing credentials scoped to specific permissions, resources, or least-privilege access for an agent. Per-key rate limits and budget caps are adjacent controls that limit volume, not privilege scope.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
